data.name: Jawah
data.gender_notes: Jawah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Jawwahah' meaning 'The Most Gracious, The Most Compassionate' in Islam, this name signifies a graceful and kind individual with a strong sense of compassion and mercy towards others. The name Jawah carries the meaning “Graceful, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jawah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies Allah's infinite mercy and compassion towards His creation, inspiring the bearer to be a source of kindness and grace in their interactions with others.
data.etymology: Jawah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
